name: repiscope
description: A periscope for your repos — see everything, touch nothing. Read-only MCP access to sibling repositories.
long_description: Repiscope lets a coding agent see your other repositories without any ability to modify them. It exposes zero repo-write tools, so the agent structurally cannot touch your code: it can list projects, get an overview, search text, and read files — nothing else. Sensitive files (keys, certs, .env, credentials) are filtered out of every tool.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List every repository visible under the configured root

tools.name: project_overview
tools.description: Structured overview of one project (file map, languages, cached summary)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Substring search across a project's text files

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read one file (size-capped, traversal-guarded, secrets filtered)

tools.name: store_summary
tools.description: Cache an agent-written summary of a project (writes only to Repiscope's own cache)

root.title: Projects root folder
root.description: The folder that contains the repositories Repiscope may read (e.g. ~/Documents/Projects). Repiscope can never write to them.
